overview: Generate a company stock research report for 腾讯控股 (0700.HK) for 2026Q1, with citations, three-statement coverage or disclosed gaps, valuation limitations, risks, and investment conclusion.
research_topic: Generate a company stock research report for 腾讯控股 (0700.HK) for 2026Q1, with citations, three-statement coverage or disclosed gaps, valuation limitations, risks, and investment conclusion.
requirements: Provide executive summary, risk assessment, and investment conclusion.
Cover three statements or explicitly disclose unavailable statement evidence.
Include valuation analysis or explicitly state why valuation is unavailable.
Bind critical conclusions to evidence IDs and citations used in report.

tasks.description: Search for and collect financial filings, earnings reports, market data, and recent news for 0700.HK for the period 2026Q1. Use evidence_discovery skill to retrieve local evidence and fetch Yahoo market snapshot. Output ranked evidence candidates with citation-ready evidence records.
tasks.expected_output: List of evidence records with fields: evidence_id, source, content, date, reliability_score.

tasks.description: Using evidence from task_001, compute financial ratios, build three-statement view (income, balance, cash flow), perform peer comparison and valuation analysis. Output evidence-backed claims for each statement line item, valuation metrics, and risk factors. If data gaps exist, explicitly note them. Every numeric claim must retain evidence_ids.
tasks.expected_output: Structured claims: each with claim_text, evidence_ids, category (financial_ratio, three_statement, valuation, peer_comp). Also a summary of data gaps.

tasks.description: Assemble the final research report using claims from task_002. Produce Markdown, HTML, and JSON outputs with sections: Executive Summary, Risk Assessment, Investment Conclusion, Three-Statement Coverage (or gap disclosure), Valuation Analysis (or limitation statement), and Compliance Disclosure. Bind critical conclusions to evidence IDs. Use report_assembly skill with chart rendering. Do not invent unsupported sections.
tasks.expected_output: Three files: report.md, report.html, report.json each containing full report with citations and compliance disclosure.

tasks.description: Verify that the final report meets all constraints: every material factual claim has an explicit evidence_id citation; no invented numbers, dates, sources; executive summary, risk assessment, investment conclusion present; three-statement coverage or gap disclosure; valuation analysis or limitation statement; critical conclusions bound to evidence IDs. If verification fails, provide detailed revision feedback.
tasks.expected_output: Verification report: pass/fail with list of issues if any.

data_sources: Tencent financial filings (quarterly reports, annual reports) for 2026Q1
Local evidence database for historical financials and peer comparisons
final_outputs: HTML report with charts and citations
JSON report with structured data and citations
